messages:
jo: opened PR #5073 to add 'bootstrap bundle' docs for private installs (semi-airgapped). includes systemd snippet, curl fallback, checksum verification. preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5073

infra-bot: CI: docs build OK  preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5073 (build 9210)

paul: quick request: add explicit curl example for constrained egress: `curl --fail --retry 4 --connect-timeout 8 --tlsv1.2 -o /var/tmp/seed.tgz https://downloads.example/seed.tgz` and show `sha256sum` verification.

tess: also note PKCS#11 socket variance for HSMs (eg `/var/run/pkcs11.sock`, `/opt/hsm/pkcs11.sock`). small sentence: "verify appliance docs for socket location".

jo: added curl + scp examples, checksum check, and a `seed-fetch.service` systemd unit with ExecStartPre for checksum.

docs-bot: Reminder: label `needs-legal` missing. Is there any export or crypto policy text needed?

jo: no new crypto guidance; just handling and deletion of cert bundles. will ping legal for quick ack and add one-liner: "treat cert bundles as secrets."

paul: tiny nit: anchor mismatch in checklist section 2.3 (`#bootstrap-seed` vs `#seed-bootstrap`). I'll raise a one-line fix in the branch.

jo: please push to branch; will fold before merge. plan: merge after legal ack and green CI. ETA today PST.

infra-bot: CI: preview updated  https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5073?update=2 (build 9213)

tess: LGTM after anchor fix. good examples and concise troubleshooting note about MTU issues on VPN overlays.

paul: approved. :white_check_mark:
